result.stdout:
USAGE:
    sharpsql [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init         Install and configure SharpSql.Sdk in a console project        
    run          Transpile and execute a project in SQL Server, using a         
                 configured connection or Testcontainers                        
    transpile    Transpile a C# source file or SDK-style project into a         
                 self-contained T-SQL batch                                     
    verify       Run C# locally and its generated SQL in a Testcontainers SQL   
                 Server, then compare outcomes

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Install and configure SharpSql.Sdk in a console project

USAGE:
    sharpsql init [PROJECT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [PROJECT]    A console .csproj or a directory containing one. Uses the      
                 current directory when omitted                                 

OPTIONS:
                                              DEFAULT                           
    -h, --help                                                   Prints help    
                                                                 information    
    -o, --output <PATH>                                          MSBuild path   
                                                                 for generated  
                                                                 SQL. Defaults  
                                                                 beside the     
                                                                 compiled       
                                                                 application    
        --entry <METHOD>                                         Entry method in
                                                                 Namespace.Type:
                                                                 :Method form.  
                                                                 The console    
                                                                 entry point is 
                                                                 used by default
        --sdk-version <VERSION>                                  SharpSql.Sdk   
                                                                 package        
                                                                 version.       
                                                                 Defaults to the
                                                                 installed tool 
                                                                 version        
        --analyzer-only

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Transpile and execute a project in SQL Server, using a configured connection or 
Testcontainers

USAGE:
    sharpsql run [INPUT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [INPUT]    A .csproj, project directory, or generated .sql file. Uses the   
               current directory when omitted                                   

OPTIONS:
                                              DEFAULT                           
    -h, --help                                           Prints help information
        --entry <METHOD>                                 Project entry method in
                                                         Namespace.Type::Method 
                                                         form                   
    -c, --configuration <CONFIGURATION>       Release    MSBuild project        
                                                         configuration          
    -f, --framework <FRAMEWORK>                          Target framework to    
                                                         select for a           
                                                         multi-targeted project 
        --connection <NAME>                              Connection string name 
                                                         from environment, user 
                                                         secrets, or appsettings
        --connection-string-env <VARIABLE>               Environment variable   
                                                         containing the         
                                                         connection string      
        --container                                      Force a SQL Server     
                                                         Testcontainer even when
                                                         a connection is        
                                                         configured             
        --keep-container                                 Keep and reuse the SQL 
           
[truncated]

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Transpile a C# source file or SDK-style project into a self-contained T-SQL 
batch

USAGE:
    sharpsql transpile [INPUT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [INPUT]    A .cs or .csproj input. Reads C# from standard input when omitted

OPTIONS:
                                           DEFAULT                              
    -h, --help                                        Prints help information   
    -o, --output <OUTPUT>                             Write generated SQL to a  
                                                      file instead of standard  
                                                      output                    
        --entry <METHOD>                              Project entry method in   
                                                      Namespace.Type::Method    
                                                      form                      
    -c, --configuration <CONFIGURATION>    Release    MSBuild project           
                                                      configuration             
    -f, --framework <FRAMEWORK>                       Target framework to select
                                                      for a multi-targeted      
                                                      project

DESCRIPTION:
Run C# locally and its generated SQL in a Testcontainers SQL Server, then 
compare outcomes

USAGE:
    sharpsql verify [INPUT] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [INPUT]    A .cs or .csproj input. Reads C# from standard input when omitted

OPTIONS:
                                           DEFAULT                              
    -h, --help                                                  Prints help     
                                                                information     
        --entry <METHOD>                                        Project entry   
                                                                method in       
                                                                Namespace.Type::
                                                                Method form     
    -c, --configuration <CONFIGURATION>    Release              MSBuild project 
                                                                configuration   
    -f, --framework <FRAMEWORK>                                 Target framework
                                                                to select for a 
                                                                multi-targeted  
                                                                project         
        --sql-output <OUTPUT>                                   Write the       
                                                                generated SQL to
                                                                a file,         
                                                                including when  
                                                                verification    
                                                                fails           
        --image <IMAGE>                    mcr.microsoft.com    SQL Server      
                                           /mssql/server:202    container image 
                                           2-latest                             
        --ti
